name: CHEG 3128
title: Chemical Engineering Junior Laboratory
description: Provides hands-on experience with heat, mass, and kinetics processes, including steady-state heat transfer, transient heat transfer, membrane separation, liquid-phase reaction kinetics, gas-phase polymerization kinetics, and microfluidic devices.
requirement_description: CHEG 3123; open only to School of Engineering students. Corequisite: CHEG 3124 and 3151.
